extracted.name: Hot Spinach Artichoke Dip
extracted.description: This spinach artichoke dip is deliciously cheesy, creamy, and easy to make! Serve this flavorful dip hot with toasted bread or tortilla chips.
ingredient_lines: 1 (14 ounce) can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
0.5 cup frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
instruction_lines: Gather all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a small baking dish.
Mix cream cheese, mayonnaise, Parmesan cheese, Romano cheese, garlic, basil, garlic salt, salt, and pepper together in a medium bowl.
Gently stir in artichoke hearts and spinach.
Transfer the mixture to the prepared baking dish; top with mozzarella cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly and lightly browned, about 25 minutes.
